research_input.frequency: FREQUENCY.md rank 38 of 42 (no first-hand report); the exam guide names Step Functions in 2.1.K16. Sub-topics: orchestration with state, retries and human approval; migrating an existing broker without code changes. Pairs: Step Functions vs SQS vs chained Lambda functions; Standard vs Express (durations from the guide); Amazon MQ vs SQS/SNS (existing JMS, AMQP or MQTT broker that cannot change). Stem signals: 'minimal code changes', 'cannot modify the application' (Amazon MQ). Step Functions is the medium-depth service; Amazon MQ and AppFlow are recognise-only service cards.
research_input.freshness: FRESHNESS.md: Step Functions variables and JSONata (2024-11-22); Lambda durable functions (2025-12) as a new option for long workflows. Amazon MQ and AppFlow were not researched in depth. Found at plan, not in FRESHNESS: Distributed Map (2022-12-01), redrive (2023-11-15), HTTPS endpoints and TestState (2023-11-26), versions and aliases (2023-06-22), customer managed keys (2024-07-25), 100,000 state machines per account (2025-02-05), IPv6 (2025-09-18), AgentCore step (2026-06-03), automatic new integrations (2026-09-15, not examinable yet); Amazon MQ CRDR for ActiveMQ (2023-06), KMS for RabbitMQ (2023-02), quorum queues (2024-07-22), PrivateLink for the MQ API (2024-12-10), RabbitMQ 4.2 with AMQP 1.0 (2025-11-20), JMS for RabbitMQ (2026-01-22), RabbitMQ private networking (2026-06-18), configurable storage (2026-07-15, boundary), RabbitMQ 4.3 (2026-09-10, not examinable yet); AppFlow Glue Data Catalog and CloudWatch metrics (2022-11).
research_input.naming: Current names: AWS Step Functions (Standard workflows, Express workflows), Amazon MQ (Amazon MQ for ActiveMQ, Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ), Amazon AppFlow. Amazon States Language. AWS SDK integrations and optimized integrations.
research_input.story: STARTUP.md chapter 32 (stage 2, month 13): the function chain of P2 waits in loops and nobody sees where a call stopped. Six steps: convert, transcribe, analyze, summarize, save, notify. Needs managed retries, waiting at no compute cost, a visible history per call. Decision: more logging / a workflow engine on EC2 / AWS Step Functions state machine call-pipeline (Standard workflow). Accepts a workflow language and a charge per state transition. Stage 4: Amazon MQ for Peldon's ActiveMQ broker; Amazon AppFlow from Salesforce to the data lake. Story numbers are story data, never facts.
